name: Soyokaze no Uta ~Breeze Passed Us By~
original_name: 微風の詩 ～Breeze passed us by～
source:
I want to see her smile... as I pondered about that... everything began...

"This summer vacation I'll get myself a girlfriend!"'

With that thought my summer vacation had begun. The girl that was my first love at a very young age... the little sister from the neighbors.

If I think about it closely, there live a lot of girls in this area that I'm potentially interested in.
I wonder what type of men these girls are into.

How much fun it would be to date one of them...

The contrast of the blue sky and the white clouds.
The sun shone brightly and the breeze blew gently 
passing past the two lovers.

I'll never forget this summer...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160321051026/http://moon2000.co.jp/tomato/soyo/]the Official website (archive)[/url]]
